desc:
Most inspiration streaks by like a meteor, vanishing in a blink. Yet while modifying this W-Engine, a surge of powerful emotion sparked an idea that anchored itself in her mind, refusing to fade. Not a shackle, nor a consuming force, but something treasured — something she longed to keep safe. That became the source of this W-Engine's design.

<color=#959595>"It's simply trying to guard the greatest treasure in this world, in the way it knows how." —She spoke softly, noticing the puzzled expressions on the Proxy siblings.</color>
desc2: Equip to increase Rupture Agents' combat capabilities
desc3: In chasing illusions, she was entranced by the light that pierced through the mist.
name: Kraken's Cradle

1.desc: When the equipper's HP decreases, their <color=#98EFF0>Ice Sheer DMG</color> increases by <color=#2BAD00>6%</color>, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 25s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. This effect can trigger once every 0.5s. When the equipper's HP falls to 50% of Max HP or below, CRIT Rate increases by <color=#2BAD00>20%</color>.
1.name: Heartfelt Caress
